# Clarity Creates Freedom

Clarity Creates Freedom is the public website of Viktors Jesilevskis, an executive technology leader and fractional CTO advisor.

## Focus

- Executive technology leadership: CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, transformation and interim leadership mandates.
- Fractional CTO advisory: technology direction, engineering operating models, delivery systems, ownership and decision clarity.
- Mentoring: practical support for engineering leaders and managers working through a live leadership decision or change.
- Engineering Lab: independent hands-on projects exploring platform engineering, engineering intelligence, automation and AI.

## Pages

- https://niceit.space/ — overview and ways to work together.
- https://niceit.space/cv.html — executive CV and leadership experience.
- https://niceit.space/fractional-cto.html — fractional CTO advisory, fit and first-month working outputs.
- https://niceit.space/mentoring.html — mentoring format, scope and contact route.
- https://niceit.space/lab.html — selected engineering projects and working methods.

The site is in English. Mentoring sessions are available online in English or Russian.
